stem: In a class survey, 30% of students have change in their pocket or purse, 20% rode a bus within the last month, and 10% both have change and rode a bus. What is the probability that a randomly chosen student has change given that they rode a bus?
explanation: P(change|bus) = P(change AND bus) / P(bus) = 0.10 / 0.20 = 0.50 [OpenStax Ch.3 p. 176].

misconceptions.A: Using P(change AND bus) directly as the conditional probability.
misconceptions.B: Using P(change) instead of conditioning on bus.
